name: approval-card
title: Approval Card
description: An agent asks its owner to approve a risky action: who asks, the action in words, the records it touches, its reason, a reassurance, the expiry, and one Approve / Decline for the whole request — then the outcome.

meta.whenToUse: Approve or decline an action an agent may not take on its own (move to Trash, share, publish) — on the record, in the inbox detail, or a sheet.
meta.whenNotToUse: A person asking for access (InboxItem actions), or confirming the viewer`s own destructive action (AlertDialog).
